moments.text: Grey-scale infrared view of a textured grey surface, crosshair at centre. A small bright dash sits below and right of the crosshair, drifting slowly left.
After a grey flash the view zooms in: the dash now shows as two or three small bright patches side by side, just below the crosshair.
Zoomed in further, the bright patches slide out of the frame and back in as the sensor pans after them.
The view zooms out; the patches form a small bright cluster drifting around the crosshair.
Zoomed in again, the patches show as two or more bright blobs in a short line. They cross the frame and leave and re-enter many times.
A bright pair drops down the right edge and slides out into the right-side black box; they are not seen again.
After a flash the view changes to darker rippled water with no bright patches until the clip ends.
